description: Create a new isolated browser session with its own cookies and state. Returns a short session ID (e.g. s_k3m7x1) to pass to all other tools. Each session is a separate BrowserContext — no cookie leakage between sessions. Pool limit: 15 concurrent sessions. Sessions auto-expire after 30 minutes of inactivity. Use keep-alive pattern (periodic navigate or snapshot) for long-running sessions.

acceptDownloads.description: Whether to accept downloads. Default: true.

cdp.description: CDP endpoint URL to connect to a running Chrome instance (e.g. 'http://localhost:9222').

clientId.description: Client identifier for per-client pool partitioning. Used with LEAP_MAX_SESSIONS_PER_CLIENT.

extensions.description: Paths to unpacked Chrome extensions to load.

headed.description: Run browser with visible UI for this session. Overrides LEAP_HEADED env var.

pinned.description: Pin this session to prevent idle timeout cleanup.

profile.description: Profile shorthand name (e.g. 'github', 'gmail'). Uses persistent Chrome profile at ~/.leapfrog/chrome-profiles/{name}/.

profilePath.description: Path to a Playwright storageState JSON file for pre-authenticated sessions.

proxy.description: Per-session proxy configuration. Each session can use a different proxy.

stealth.description: Enable/disable stealth mode for this session. Default: true (uses global setting).

name: session_create
title: Create Browser Session
